decision: continue fixed12.25h protocol, preserve best; no hyperparameter change
qualification: Fixed observations and RNG mean this is not simply resampling evaluation noise.
Finite correlated validation subset and stochastic AdamW trajectory can produce checkpoint fluctuations.
Training loss uses augmentation/random noise and4dp console means; do not treat train-val difference as an exact generalization gap.
One increase does not establish overfitting or justify changing the protocol.

heuristic_review_triggers.hard_failure: nonfinite metrics, CUDA/NCCL failure, unreadable checkpoint, verified data/stats drift; stop only own task and diagnose
heuristic_review_triggers.quality_review: 3 consecutive validation checkpoints >best*1.15 and rising while train improves, or persistent degradation after LR floor; review without automatic protocol change
heuristic_review_triggers.severe_quality_review: 3 checkpoints >=best*2 or sustained order-of-magnitude loss/gradient jumps; diagnose at a safe checkpoint
heuristic_review_triggers.qualification: Operational heuristics, not significance thresholds; no current trigger met.
